title: [YouPass Collect] - Ground floor changes over three periods
prompt: The plans below show how the ground floor of a particular building has changed over time. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The plans illustrate how the ground floor layout of a building was altered over three distinct periods: 1958-1984, 1985-2000, and 2001 to the present day.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, the building underwent significant transformations, changing from an office to an apartment, and finally to a flower shop. Notably, the kitchen and entrance remained in their original positions throughout all three periods.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: In the first period, the building functioned as an office, with a meeting room and kitchen occupying the upper section. The left side housed the assistant's and secretary's offices, while a larger manager's office was situated on the right. At the bottom, there was a toilet on the left and a reception area adjacent to the entrance. When the building was converted into an apartment between 1985 and 2000, these work spaces were completely redesigned. The upper left area became a spacious living room, while the kitchen retained its position. The former office spaces on the left were replaced by a bathroom with shower facilities, and two bedrooms were added on the right side.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: From 2001 onwards, the apartment was transformed into a flower shop. The living room area was converted into a gift cards section and a large flower display area. The bathroom was replaced by a children's play area, while the bedrooms gave way to an office and another flower section. The kitchen, however, continued to occupy its original location in the upper right corner.
